questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Inclusiveness and a strong academic atmosphere were crucial factors in choosing my study destination. I wanted to study in an environment where people from diverse backgrounds feel welcomed and respected, while also being surrounded by a motivating and intellectually stimulating academic community.

Additional comments:

questions.answer: Not really easy. I have to get a lot of crucial information from other students and by writing emails to the institute.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I would like to have clearer guide on the courses enrollment and registration, espeically if there is any exceptions for exchange students.

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: I was assigned a room in a student residence on campus.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: There was a shared kitchen in the student residence, so I could prepare my own meals.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Living in on-campus housing was convenient and made it easy to meet other students, especially other exchange and international students. Future exchange students should be prepared to share common facilities and be respectful of the shared living environment.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: The registration process was somewhat confusing and required some time to figure out. I was not aware of the exact start date of the semester at first. In addition, all of the courses I initially registered for were rejected because students from other majors were required to apply through a different platform, which I had not been informed about in advance. As a result, I had to spend quite a lot of time finding out how to enroll in the appropriate courses and later how to register for the exams. Clearer information and instructions for exchange students would have made the process much easier.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The teachers and tutors were very helpful and approachable. They were willing to answer questions and provide guidance whenever I needed help.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: In the end I get registered in.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I would recommend that future exchange students carefully check the registration requirements and platforms in advance. It would also be helpful if the host institution provided clearer and more detailed guidance, especially regarding course registration, important deadlines, and exam registration.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *

Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I took courses in psychology, which demands some academic background.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Compared with UCPH, the teaching at my host institution involved a heavier workload, but I also found the topics more interesting and engaging. The courses were challenging, but they gave me the opportunity to explore subjects that I found particularly interesting.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer: CM 3: Psychology & Society, interesting and broad topic selections.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: I did not encounter any major unexpected costs during my exchange.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Food and everyday expenses were somewhat more expensive than I expected, while accommodation was relatively affordable compared with what I had anticipated.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: There were student gatherings and social events organized by different faculties. These activities provided opportunities to meet other students, socialize, and get to know people within the faculty.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I’d recommend joining the student gatherings organized by the different faculties. They are a good way to meet local and international students, make friends, and get more involved in student life outside of your academic studies.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I recommend exploring the city to get to know the local culture, visit different places, and experience everyday life outside the university.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was relatively easy to adjust to the local culture. People were welcoming and open-minded, and I gradually became familiar with the local lifestyle and customs through daily life and interactions with other students.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: There were some differences in everyday habits and communication styles.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The openness and inclusiveness of the culture. I also enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere and the opportunity to interact with people from different cultural backgrounds.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Check the course registration requirements carefully, especially if you are taking courses outside your major.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: I would recommend checking all important information and registration requirements carefully before arriving, especially regarding course registration and exams. Some processes may be different from UCPH, so it is better to ask the host institution if anything is unclear.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting people from different backgrounds and cultures. It was a great opportunity to make new friends, learn from others, and experience life from different perspectives.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Figuring out the course registration and exam registration process, as the procedures were different from what I was used to at UCPH.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
